1.consolidated_definition: Planta de hasta 1 m de altura, de tallos ramificados angulados, hojas alternas pecioladas ovadas, flores solitarias en forma de campanilla amarillo cremosa y fruto en baya globosa; tiene propiedades medicinales. Solanaceae, Physalis angulata.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Plant with a height of up to 1 m, having branched and angled stems, alternate ovate leaves on petioles, solitary yellowish-creamy bell-shaped flowers, and globular berry fruit; it has medicinal properties. Solanaceae, Physalis angulata.
